title: When the Yearbook Wakes
author: Theo Delacroix
blurb: Isandro Iversen, the new kid at a school built over something old, has spent ten years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
